meta.name: From a Night Porter's Point of View
meta.description:
An authoritarian personality describes itself as common sense: Kieślowski gives a factory night porter who adores rules, informers and surveillance enough rope to explain his whole worldview, delighted with himself throughout.

At the time of the Polish social regime, a security officer is promoted to work at a prison yard. Introducing concurrently with the narrator; he speaks of himself, his thoughts, his point of view.
